title: "abc" + 1 is an error: the text is not a number

expected.error: the text "abc" cannot be converted to a number for the addition

source.quote: the string is automatically converted into a corresponding number, as long as the string is a valid representation of a number
source.supports: the conversion only works for text that represents a number

source.quote: If the data in the column you specify as an argument is incompatible with the data type the function requires, DAX might return an error
source.supports: a value that cannot be converted is an error

derivation: "abc" is not a valid representation of a number, so the implicit conversion that + needs fails and the query fails.
